articles.title: CJP stir: 4 men arrested over viral video of assault on protester
articles.description: Four men have been arrested in Delhi after a viral social media video showed a woman being assaulted. The police took action after learning the accused planned to flee the Delhi-NCR region. No formal complaint has been filed by the alleged victim or any organization regarding the incident. The police acted swiftly upon receiving information about the accused's intention to abscond.

articles.title: SC & HC judges being appointed by Modi, not collegium, says ex-judge
articles.description: Former judge K Chandru criticized the lack of transparency in the judicial appointment process. He argued that the National Judicial Appointments Commission was never revived after being struck down by the Supreme Court. Justice S Muralidhar highlighted the lack of women judges elevated to the Supreme Court. Raju Ramachandran and Justice K Kannan also contributed discussions on relevant judicial topics.

articles.title: ‘Shami bhi aa rahe hai piche piche’: Raina drops big hint on India pacer’s return
articles.description: Suresh Raina expressed optimism about Mohammed Shami's potential return to the national team. After Bhuvneshwar Kumar's successful comeback, Raina highlighted Shami's strong domestic performances. Despite concerns regarding Shami's IPL statistics, Raina remains confident in his abilities. Bhuvneshwar's recent contributions illustrate how discipline can lead to opportunities in international cricket. Raina noted that Shami is closely following Kumar's path to making a return.

In 1929, J. M. Barrie gifted Peter Pan rights to a hospital; UK law protects its royalties
articles.description: In 1929, J. M. Barrie selflessly granted the rights to Peter Pan, establishing a perpetual source of funding for Great Ormond Street Hospital. The hospital benefits from the story's performances, facilitating care for critically ill children. A unique UK law safeguards this donation, ensuring royalties persist beyond copyright expiry. Barrie's ties to the hospital remain influential, demonstrating the power of literature in sustaining charitable endeavors.

articles.title: James Patterson raised his 2015 school library donation to $1.75m, helping 467 US libraries
articles.description: James Patterson initially pledged $1.25 million to support US school libraries but increased the donation to $1.75 million. This increase followed an overwhelming response from schools, revealing their pressing needs for resources. A total of 467 libraries benefited from the grants, funding books, technology, and repairs. The American Association of School Librarians recognized Patterson for his advocacy and financial contributions.

articles.title: Man faces Rs 17.18 lakh tax penalty over Rs 55.62 lakh unexplained deposits; ITAT gives relief
articles.description: A man had not filed an income tax return for assessment year 2016-17. The amount was treated as unexplained cash deposits in a bank account that the department attributed to him.

articles.title: Five Indiana engineering students built a 12-hour wearable that helps visually impaired users detect obstacles beyond a cane or guide dog
articles.description: Rose-Hulman students have developed a remarkable wearable device tailored for visually impaired individuals. This innovative headgear employs advanced sensors to identify surrounding obstacles, providing users with haptic feedback. With a remarkable twelve-hour battery life on a single charge, this device empowers users with greater independence. The project's goal is to enhance the day-to-day experiences of those with vision impairments.

articles.title: ‘Amitabh Bachchan is a hero for us, but he’s allowed to be human': Abhishek Bachchan
articles.description: Amitabh Bachchan is celebrating his 84th birthday on October 11 with numerous wishes from admirers. On the occasion, here's recalling the time when Abhishek Bachchan shared insights about their family dynamics and his father's dual role as a star and family man. He also spoke about how his parents feel about his career and how seeing his father at home despite being a superstar, taught him to stay detach from fame early on in life.

articles.title: Rajinikanth’s 230 avatars feature in special Navratri Kolu
articles.description: Rajinikanth's fans honor him with a special kolu at the Azhagumigu Sri Rajini Temple for Navratri. This year's display features over 230 photos showcasing his cinematic journey through multiple films. Karthik, a devoted fan, began this tradition three years ago and has continued expanding it each year. The temple conducts daily pujas and offers prasadam to visitors, enhancing the community's connection to the actor.

articles.title: Dileep says fans’ prayers helped him through 10-year ordeal
articles.description: In a heartfelt moment at the Dileep Fans Association event in Qatar, Dileep reflected on the steadfast loyalty of his fans throughout a decade filled with challenges. He shared his struggles to speak out due to ongoing legal barriers, and expressed deep gratitude for their prayers and support. His latest film, 'Neekkam', explores a complex psychological game centered on a father-daughter bond.

articles.title: Chiranjeevi calls Amitabh Bachchan his ‘dearest Guru Ji’ on 84th birthday
articles.description: Chiranjeevi shared his heartfelt birthday wishes for Amitabh Bachchan, commending his unwavering passion for cinema and artistry. As Bachchan marked his 84th year, an outpouring of affection from fans and industry peers followed. Chiranjeevi noted Bachchan's genuine humility, a trait that distinguishes him. Their past collaboration in 'Sye Raa Narasimha Reddy' remains noteworthy. Meanwhile, Chiranjeevi is gearing up for the release of 'Kaaka' around the Sankranti festival.
